title: OpenCut — Discovery
script: A free editor can be exciting without being your next production tool. OpenCut is an open-source editor. Its current README says the project is being rewritten, with the classic version still available. I am testing the classic version people can use today: can it handle an ordinary vertical edit? Then I need text, sound, and an export I can actually open. Open source tells me something about access. It does not tell me whether this version fits my deadline. Next: the same Reel in OpenCut and CapCut, with every missing step recorded.
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Current editor and development status rather than a CapCut-killer claim.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: A free editor can be exciting without being your next production tool.
OpenCut has a rewrite. I am testing the classic editor.
Open source does not guarantee a deadline-ready edit.
strongestHook: A free editor can be exciting without being your next production tool.
directorBrief: Direct this as a useful discovery with one important limit: Current editor and development status rather than a CapCut-killer claim. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: The current official README states a rewrite and points users to the classic version. Record classic app URL and version/build identifier; keep rewrite preview separate. Use three original short clips, licensed/original music and a title. Capture import, timeline interaction and available export options. Missing operation is a finding, not permission to create a simulated screenshot.
evidenceRequirements: Verify repo, current star count, license and rewrite status.

instagramCaption: OpenCut — Discovery. Current editor and development status rather than a CapCut-killer claim. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. Next: the same Reel in OpenCut and CapCut, with every missing step recorded.
tiktokCaption: OpenCut — Discovery. SAME REEL. FULL CHECKLIST.
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
